_meta.note: Captured by scripts/capture_muse_frames.py off the fork adapter dist/index.js driven over stdio against Muse Code 1.4.11 (MUSE_CODE_EXECUTABLE=host muse), a signed-in account, so the model answered live. Agent-to-client lines in order. Crew's FULL two-part seed was sent, imported from the harness module: initialize clientCapabilities._meta[muse/approval]=1, and session/new _meta[muse/approval]={"policy": "promptUnmatched", "profile": ":ask-me"}. Covers the initialize result (protocolVersion, agentInfo.version); the session/new result whose configOptions read BOTH nativeApprovalPolicy.currentValue=promptUnmatched AND nativePermissionProfile.currentValue=:ask-me back in the SAME response; and the absent-id session/load rejection (-32602, this host's shape, NOT -32002). Reductions: the session id is replaced with the synthetic muse-session-1. The ids are synthetic; nothing else is altered.

configOptions.name: Native permission profile
configOptions.description: The host permission profile selected for this session. Ask me attaches a human reviewer so session-mounted MCP tool calls draw a permission request; the host default (Auto-review) clears them without one. Proven at session start; a profile the catalog does not admit fails the session rather than falling back to the default.
